name: LDN Verifiable Market Agent
description: Read-only public web prototype that independently hashes Concordium CIS-8004 Agent Cards and requires an Active, recent registry record before displaying a dated CoinMarketCap market-breadth sample. Not an autonomous trading agent. This card is NOT YET registered on-chain; our own Concordium agent registration and credential proof are pending.

skills.name: Verify Concordium registry and card integrity
skills.description: Inspect a public CIS-8004 agent on Concordium testnet or mainnet; check status, indexer sync lag, Agent Card URL, and a browser-computed SHA-256 of fetched bytes against the registry commitment.

skills.name: Gate a historical market-breadth report by agent integrity
skills.description: Show source-attributed November 20 2026 CoinMarketCap top-10 sample market metrics only after a third-party sample agent's registry and card match. This is historical, not live price trading or autonomous execution.
